about: Ship Desk: TCGplayer shipping CSV -> address labels, packing slips, envelopes, shipping plan + stamps, mark-shipped import file (local, offline browser app)

runs.title: First build of Ship Desk + landscape thermal label
runs.summary: A 4-station nodeterm team built a local copy of what tcgspeedshipper.com does from one contract; QA proved it end to end (113 tests), then a landscape 6x4 thermal label was added (117 tests).

stages.name: Plan
stages.note: research, contract, briefs, test harness, vendored libraries

sessions.did: Read the site and sample CSV, wrote CONTRACT.md + 4 briefs, serve.py, headless-Edge test harness, vendored jsPDF/pdf.js/qrcode
CSV reader, shipping plan + stamps, tracking match, TCGplayer import + Pirate Ship files, paste parser, sample CSV; 39 tests
8 label formats, packing slips, design options, TCGplayer slip-PDF reader; 50 tests
4-step page, return-address profiles, offline service worker, Start Ship Desk.bat; 13 tests

stages.name: QA
stages.note: armed after-success on all three builders

sessions.did: 9 end-to-end tests (113 total), 16 screenshots checked, README + test report, 3 small fixes
Re-ran all tests, looked at screenshots, added landscape thermal 6x4 label (117 tests)

lessons: A test harness proven before launch (headless Edge, results POSTed back) let every station test on a PC without Node.
File ownership + a Requests section in each brief kept parallel stations out of each other's files.
Check each vendored download separately: one failed silently in an && chain.

runs.title: History tab + Saved folder
runs.summary: The orchestrator session added a History page of every order labelled or shipped, and made every generated file save into Ship Desk's own Saved folder instead of Downloads (130 tests).

sessions.did: history.js + History page; serve.py /api/save + /api/open-folder, Saved/ gitignored; 13 new tests

lessons: Files a local app writes for the user that hold customer data must be gitignored before the first write when the repo is public.
A localhost endpoint that writes files must check Host, Origin and a custom header, or any website the user visits can write there.

runs.title: Phone photos, label scanning, sideways label fix
runs.summary: The orchestrator session added an iPhone page for order photos (through Tailscale, with an offline queue), fixed the cut-off sideways label, and added order QR codes plus mailer tracking-barcode scanning that feeds History (144 tests).

sessions.did: phone.html/js + offline IndexedDB queue, serve.py phone API + Tailscale switch + pairing code, History photos; sideways label as upright page; order QR on prints, zxing scanner, tracking links into History; 14 new tests

lessons: Thermal printers don't rotate a wide PDF page onto a narrow roll; they cut it off. Draw a landscape label turned on an upright page.
An iPhone that can't reach the PC on a double-NAT LAN can use `tailscale serve` (tailnet only) with the server still on 127.0.0.1; treat proxied requests as a separate, restricted client.
Headless --virtual-time-budget screenshots don't wait for IndexedDB; use real-time DevTools capture.
A canvas captureStream() makes a fake camera for testing getUserMedia scanners in headless Edge.

runs.title: Mailer entries, camera screen, post office = shipped, photo turning
runs.summary: The orchestrator session turned unknown mailer scans into History entries, made the scanner a multi-photo camera that turns sideways shots upright, marked orders shipped from post office photos, and added photo turn buttons on the PC (148 tests).

sessions.did: mailer:<tracking> entries + Add order # in History with photo re-key; camera screen with shutter, type switch and tilt-based turning; post office photo -> shipped note; PC photo turn buttons; Windows file-replace retry; 4 new tests

events.text: A failed patch script emptied app/js/phone.js; rebuilt from git and re-applied

lessons: Write a file only after its new content is fully encoded: open(..., 'w') empties it before a failing write.
On Windows, os.replace onto a JSON file that another thread is reading raises PermissionError: retry briefly.
Photos shot straight down at a desk lose their orientation; a web camera can use devicemotion gravity and keep the last turn while flat.

runs.title: File names that say what is inside, camera asked for once
runs.summary: The orchestrator session named saved files by time and buyers and kept the phone camera ready between uses so the iPhone stops re-asking (148 tests).

sessions.did: fileName() for labels/slips/import/Pirate Ship/history, wider NAME_OK; camera stream kept 5 min after Done and reused; tests updated

lessons: An iPhone home-screen web app re-asks for the camera on each getUserMedia call: keep and reuse the stream for a while.

runs.title: Tracking barcodes read much better
runs.summary: The orchestrator session benchmarked barcode reading on 96 phone-like mailer pictures, found zxing-js failing beside darker mailers, and switched the phone to zxing-wasm (15 -> 50 of 96) with a JS fallback (150 tests).

sessions.did: barcode benchmark; JS strip reader with local thresholds; zxing-wasm 3.1.6 vendored as main reader; serve.py wasm type + phone files; 2 new tests

lessons: zxing-js 1D reading uses a whole-row threshold: a dark surface beside a white label makes it fail; zxing-wasm (zxing-cpp) read 3x more phone-like barcode pictures.
Measure barcode readers on generated camera-like pictures (blur, tilt, grain, background) before tuning.

runs.title: On/off switch, background, start with Windows
runs.summary: The orchestrator session added an on/off switch to the page (shutdown + shipdesk://start), made Ship Desk run windowless in the background, fixed two copies sharing the port, and added Start with Windows (152 tests).

sessions.did: header on/off switch, /api/ping + /api/shutdown, shipdesk:// launcher; pythonw background start, log, Stop bat; SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE; Start with Windows (HKCU Run); 2 new tests; live checks

events.text: Live test found two Ship Desks on one port (old window re-ran the edited .bat); fixed with an exclusive port

lessons: On Windows, Python http.server sets SO_REUSEADDR, so a second server can bind the same port: use SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE.
cmd reads a running .bat from disk as it goes: editing it while an old window runs it can run the new lines.
